title: Frequently asked questions
intro: Public information for visitors who are not signed in — no user data is exposed.

q2: Does a mutual match create Couple Space?
a2: No. A mutual match only opens chat. Couple Space requires a separate invitation and consent from both people.
q3: Are map or journal data used for ranking?
a3: No. Private journals and precise GPS are not used by the matching engine.
